cues: The basal cell divides again and again into a row of six to ten cells, the suspensor, which pushes the embryo deep into the endosperm.
Its lowest cell swells into a haustorium.
The apical cell divides into eight cells: the octant.
text: The basal cell divides again and again into a row of six to ten cells, the suspensor, which pushes the embryo deep into the endosperm. Its lowest cell swells into a haustorium. The apical cell divides into eight cells: the octant.
